author: RedDeadFed
quote:
My first issue is that this game did not come out physically on a disc. I am someone on a budget who often immediately sells his games after playing to recoup the cost. They could have easily put it on a disc, even if it was just a game key type of situation, but I understand that they want to maximize profits.

So anyway, I purchased this on my PS5 Pro, digitally reluctantly. I got the $80 USD version. Immediately I was disappointed with how choppy the framerate is. Usually games give you an option for 60fps or 30fps, but on this game there is only a 30fps option which makes me nauseous to play sometimes. For me this is a huge issue. It is especially jarring in scenes where there is a lot of action and the camera needs to agressively be spun around. 

The third major issue I have with the game is Jason's voice actor. I absolutely cannot stand hearing him talk. I thought I would get used to it, but 12 hours in it was still incredibly annoying to listen to and took me out of the immersion. He sounds like he is talking through a towel.

My final gripes come from the actual gameplay of the game. I tried getting into the story, but it often felt so tedious the things that the game suggested I do. Early in the game I found myself with a nailgun putting singles on a roof and shortly after was power washing a boat. I don't know how skippable this stuff is, but it's not the immersion that I was looking for. I get that they want everything to be realistic, but c'mon. 

Honestly, I wish I could have refunded, but Sony has a policy that makes it basically impossible to get a refund, even if it's early on. I would recommend people save their money or at the very least wait til a sale or physical disc copy is released.
